data.long_meaning: Nabaah means a stream, a source or a gushing water. It is derived from the Arabic word 'Naba' which means to gush or to flow. The name Nabaah carries the meaning “Stream, Source” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Nabaah usually hope their child will grow to embody stream, source and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being a name from the Quran, Nabaah symbolizes the divine blessings that flow in the life of the person named so.
data.etymology: Nabaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Stream, Source.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nabaah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
